increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Floor standing, Protection class IP-42, Suitable for 132KW, 1440 rpm Motor. Unit: Each Qty: 2 Special Terms & Conditions: 1. Civil, Mechanical works & Panel Mounting not in vendor's scope. 2. Supply, laying & termination of Power Cable not in vendor's scope while control cable termination in ven dor's scope. 3.Commissioning shall be included in the supply order and shall not be treated as an extra-cost item. Mini mum 3 working days at site shall be included. 4.Perfomance Guarantee Minimum 12 months from the date of successful commissioning or 18 months fro m the date of supply, whichever is earlier. During the warranty period, defects attributable to the supplied equipment shall be attended by the supplier without additional charges. 5. Supplier shall provide, as applicable : General Arrangement (GA) drawing ,Single Line Diagram (SLD),Po wer circuit diagram, Control circuit diagram, Terminal/wiring diagram, VFD datasheet ,VFD catalogue/man ual, Bill of Material, Protection and parameter-setting details, Communication details, Recommended spare parts list, Operation and maintenance manual, Test/FAT report, Routine test certificates, Commissioning re port ,As-built drawings after completion of commissioning. 6.Note: Size of Panel i.e width of panel should exceed 900mm (Permissible limit) 7.Inspection at vendor's sites as per specification by CFP Representative. Dispatch shall be made only afte r satisfactory inspection/testing and approval by SAIL. 8. Party has to supply material in proper packing to withstand transit; free replacement in case of transit d amage. 9. Supply of material as per attached drawings/specification and approved Bill of Material Including Commi ssioning. 10. Delivery Period - 6 Months after Placement of PO 11. Payment Terms as per SAIL P1 : 70% after reciept of VFD Panel/ Material at CFP site, 20% after commis sioning of Drives and 10% with 100% taxes & duties after completion of performance guarantee period.

12.
